name: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
steps: Lie on one side on the floor with your bottom arm supporting your head and your bottom leg extended completely straight.
Step your top foot across in front of your bottom thigh and plant it flat on the floor with that knee bent upward.
Flex your bottom foot and contract your inner thigh to raise your straight bottom leg smoothly upward toward the ceiling.
Lower your bottom leg slowly just short of touching the floor, and switch sides after finishing one leg.
tips: Keep your torso and hips stacked sideways rather than rocking backward to lift your leg higher.
Pause briefly at the top of each lift to maximize inner-thigh engagement.
